description: Does reduced CA1 pyramidal neuron burden capture donor-level memory decline beyond age, sex, Braak stage, and CERAD score?
Does enrichment of reactive astrocytes within CA1 capture a gliosis signal for memory decline that is complementary to the accepted CA1 pyramidal neuron burden marker?

Does reactive astrocyte localization around CA1 pyramidal neurons capture a neuron-adjacent gliosis niche associated with memory decline beyond bulk CA1 neuronal loss and bulk reactive astrocyte enrichment?
Does hypertrophy of CA1 reactive astrocytes, relative to homeostatic CA1 astrocytes, capture a reactive-state severity signal for memory decline beyond existing CA1 cell-composition markers?

Does focal self-clustering of CA1 reactive astrocytes, relative to baseline CA1 astrocyte clustering, capture a patchy gliosis severity signal for memory decline beyond existing CA1 burden, enrichment, neuron-adjacent niche, and hypertrophy markers?

Does the fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons exposed to focal reactive-astrocyte hotspots, relative to exposure to baseline astrocyte hotspots, capture neuron-facing gliosis burden beyond the current CA1 panel?

Do CA1 reactive astrocyte hotspots occupy locally pyramidal-depleted niches, relative to baseline astrocyte hotspots, and does that focal neuron-loss pattern add signal beyond the current CA1 gliosis panel?

Do CA1 reactive astrocyte hotspots sit in oligodendrocyte-poor niches, relative to matched homeostatic astrocyte hotspots, and does that focal glia-myelin support failure add signal beyond the current CA1 neuron-loss/gliosis panel?

Do CA1 reactive astrocyte hotspots sit in corpora-amylacea-rich niches, relative to matched homeostatic astrocyte hotspots, and does that focal chronic waste-accumulation signal add information beyond the current CA1 gliosis panel?

Do CA1 reactive astrocyte hotspots occupy lymphocyte-enriched local niches, relative to matched homeostatic astrocyte hotspots, and does that focal immune signal improve prediction of slope_zmem0 beyond the current CA1 panel?
